affirmations.en: You do not have to do it all today. The next small thing is enough.
affirmations.text: Huhitaji kufanya kila kitu leo. Jambo dogo linalofuata linatosha.

affirmations.en: Tired is not the same as failing. You are tired because you keep showing up.
affirmations.text: Kuchoka si kushindwa. Umechoka kwa sababu unaendelea kuwepo kila siku.

affirmations.en: The dishes can wait. You are allowed to sit down for five minutes.
affirmations.text: Vyombo vinaweza kusubiri. Una haki ya kuketi kwa dakika tano.

affirmations.en: Cereal for dinner still counts as feeding your family.
affirmations.text: Nafaka kwa chakula cha jioni bado ni kuilisha familia yako.

affirmations.en: Rest is not something you have to earn. You are allowed to rest right now.
affirmations.text: Kupumzika si kitu unachopaswa kukistahili. Unaweza kupumzika sasa hivi.

affirmations.en: Some days the win is that everyone made it to bedtime. That is a real win.
affirmations.text: Siku nyingine ushindi ni kwamba kila mtu amefika salama hadi wakati wa kulala. Huo ni ushindi wa kweli.

affirmations.en: You are doing more than anyone sees. I see it.
affirmations.text: Unafanya mengi kuliko mtu yeyote anavyoona. Mimi naona.

affirmations.en: A messy house and loved kids. That is a good trade.
affirmations.text: Nyumba iliyovurugika na watoto wanaopendwa. Hiyo ni biashara nzuri.

affirmations.en: Your best looks different on a hard day, and it still counts.
affirmations.text: Siku ngumu, juhudi zako bora huonekana tofauti, na bado zinahesabika.

affirmations.en: One deep breath. Drop your shoulders. You are doing okay.
affirmations.text: Pumua kwa kina mara moja. Shusha mabega. Unaendelea vizuri.

affirmations.en: It is okay to lower the bar today. You can raise it again another day.
affirmations.text: Ni sawa kupunguza matarajio leo. Unaweza kuyainua tena siku nyingine.

affirmations.en: Asking for help is a strong thing to do, not a weak one.
affirmations.text: Kuomba msaada ni ujasiri, si udhaifu.

affirmations.en: You are allowed to say no to one more thing.
affirmations.text: Una haki ya kukataa jambo moja zaidi.

affirmations.en: If today felt lonely, you are not the only mom who felt that way. There are a lot of us.
affirmations.text: Kama leo ulijisikia mpweke, wewe si mama pekee aliyejisikia hivyo. Tuko wengi.

affirmations.en: You deserve a friend who asks how you are and waits for the answer.
affirmations.text: Unastahili rafiki anayekuuliza hali yako na kusubiri jibu.

affirmations.en: It is okay to reach out first. Most moms are hoping someone will.
affirmations.text: Ni sawa kuwa wa kwanza kuwasiliana. Akina mama wengi wanatumaini mtu atafanya hivyo.

affirmations.en: Feeling unseen does not mean you do not matter. You matter a great deal.
affirmations.text: Kujisikia kama hakuna anayekuona hakumaanishi kwamba wewe si muhimu. Wewe ni muhimu sana.

affirmations.en: Your feelings make sense. You are not too much.
affirmations.text: Hisia zako zina maana. Wewe si mzigo.

affirmations.en: You do not have to explain your hard day here. We get it.
affirmations.text: Hapa huhitaji kueleza siku yako ngumu. Tunaelewa.

affirmations.en: A text to another mom that says “me too” can turn a whole day around.
affirmations.text: Ujumbe kwa mama mwingine unaosema "mimi pia" unaweza kubadilisha siku nzima.

affirmations.en: Feeding, changing, rocking, repeat. That is real work, even when it looks like sitting still.
affirmations.text: Kulisha, kubadilisha nepi, kubembeleza, na tena upya. Hiyo ni kazi halisi, hata inapoonekana kama kukaa tu.

affirmations.en: You and your baby are still learning each other. There is no rush.
affirmations.text: Wewe na mtoto wako bado mnajifunza kufahamiana. Hakuna haraka.

affirmations.en: The days with a newborn are long. This stretch will not last forever.
affirmations.text: Siku na mtoto mchanga ni ndefu. Kipindi hiki hakitadumu milele.

affirmations.en: If all you did today was keep a tiny person fed and warm, you did a big job.
affirmations.text: Kama leo ulichofanya ni kumtunza mtu mdogo ashibe na apate joto, umefanya kazi kubwa.

affirmations.en: You do not need to bounce back. You can just be where you are.
affirmations.text: Huhitaji kurudi haraka ulivyokuwa. Unaweza kuwa tu pale ulipo.

affirmations.en: However your baby is fed, you are taking care of your baby. That is what counts.
affirmations.text: Vyovyote mtoto wako anavyolishwa, unamtunza. Hilo ndilo muhimu.

affirmations.en: You can be short on sleep and full of love at the same time.
affirmations.text: Unaweza kukosa usingizi na kujaa upendo kwa wakati mmoja.

affirmations.en: Hold the baby and let the house go. The house will still be here.
affirmations.text: Mbebe mtoto na uache kazi za nyumba. Nyumba bado itakuwepo.

affirmations.en: A meltdown in the store does not make you a bad mom. It means you have a toddler.
affirmations.text: Mtoto kulia na kugaagaa dukani hakukufanyi mama mbaya. Inamaanisha tu una mtoto mdogo.

affirmations.en: Little ones test the limits because they feel safe with you.
affirmations.text: Watoto wadogo hujaribu mipaka kwa sababu wanajisikia salama wakiwa nawe.

affirmations.en: You stayed calm one minute longer than yesterday. That counts.
affirmations.text: Leo ulibaki mtulivu dakika moja zaidi kuliko jana. Hilo linahesabika.

affirmations.en: If you lost your temper, a hug and a sorry fixes a lot. That teaches them something good too.
affirmations.text: Kama ulikasirika, kumbatio na "samahani" vinarekebisha mengi. Na vinawafundisha jambo jema pia.

affirmations.en: Sticky hands, loud voices, big feelings. You are raising a whole person.
affirmations.text: Mikono inayonata, sauti kubwa, hisia kubwa. Unalea mtu kamili.

affirmations.en: The fifth “why?” of the hour is a little mind growing.
affirmations.text: "Kwa nini?" ya tano katika saa hii ni akili ndogo inayokua.

affirmations.en: You do not need a perfect day to make a happy memory.
affirmations.text: Huhitaji siku kamilifu ili kutengeneza kumbukumbu ya furaha.

affirmations.en: A slammed door is not the end of the story. Keep the porch light on.
affirmations.text: Mlango uliobamizwa si mwisho wa hadithi. Acha taa iwake.

affirmations.en: Your teen may not say it, but your steady presence matters.
affirmations.text: Kijana wako anaweza asiseme, lakini uwepo wako wa kila siku una maana kubwa.

affirmations.en: Being the calm one in the house is hard work. You are doing it.
affirmations.text: Kuwa mtulivu ndani ya nyumba ni kazi ngumu. Na unaifanya.

affirmations.en: Some of the best talks happen in the car. Keep driving.
affirmations.text: Baadhi ya mazungumzo bora hutokea garini. Endelea kuendesha.

affirmations.en: They pull away to grow up, not to leave you behind.
affirmations.text: Wanajitenga ili wakue, si ili wakuache nyuma.

affirmations.en: You do not need every answer. Listening is a big part of it.
affirmations.text: Huhitaji kuwa na majibu yote. Kusikiliza ni sehemu kubwa ya jambo hili.

affirmations.en: Big kids still need you, just in quieter ways.
affirmations.text: Watoto wakubwa bado wanakuhitaji, ila kwa njia za kimya zaidi.

affirmations.en: Doing it on your own takes a strength most people never see.
affirmations.text: Kufanya yote peke yako kunahitaji nguvu ambayo watu wengi hawaioni kamwe.

affirmations.en: You are enough parent for your child. You always have been.
affirmations.text: Kama mama, unamtosha mtoto wako. Umekuwa hivyo siku zote.

affirmations.en: One set of hands, a hundred jobs. Go easy on yourself.
affirmations.text: Mikono miwili, kazi mia. Jihurumie.

affirmations.en: Your kids are learning what a strong, loving person looks like by watching you.
affirmations.text: Watoto wako wanajifunza, wakikutazama, jinsi mtu mwenye nguvu na upendo anavyokuwa.

affirmations.en: Taking a break is not leaving your post. It is how you keep going.
affirmations.text: Kupumzika si kuacha kazi yako. Ndivyo unavyoweza kuendelea.

affirmations.en: Nobody is keeping score. Love and showing up are what matter.
affirmations.text: Hakuna anayehesabu alama. Upendo na kuwepo ndivyo muhimu.

affirmations.en: Grief and love come from the same place. Missing someone shows how much you loved them.
affirmations.text: Majonzi na upendo hutoka mahali pamoja. Kumkumbuka mtu kunaonyesha jinsi ulivyompenda.

affirmations.en: There is no right timeline for grief. Take the time you need.
affirmations.text: Hakuna ratiba sahihi ya maombolezo. Chukua muda unaohitaji.

affirmations.en: On the hard anniversaries, be as gentle with yourself as you would be with a friend.
affirmations.text: Katika kumbukumbu ngumu za kila mwaka, jionee huruma kama ungemwonea rafiki.

affirmations.en: You can carry sadness and still laugh with your kids. Both are real.
affirmations.text: Unaweza kubeba huzuni na bado ukacheka na watoto wako. Yote mawili ni ya kweli.

affirmations.en: If you lost a pregnancy or a baby, that loss is real, and so is your love.
affirmations.text: Kama ulipoteza mimba au mtoto, hasara hiyo ni ya kweli, na upendo wako pia.

affirmations.en: Some days grief is quiet and some days it is loud. Both are okay.
affirmations.text: Siku nyingine huzuni huwa kimya, na siku nyingine huwa na kelele. Yote ni sawa.

affirmations.en: Being short on money does not make you short on love.
affirmations.text: Kuwa na pesa kidogo hakumaanishi kuwa na upendo kidogo.

affirmations.en: Your kids will remember the time with you more than the things you bought.
affirmations.text: Watoto wako watakumbuka muda waliokaa nawe kuliko vitu ulivyowanunulia.

affirmations.en: Asking about help with bills is smart, not shameful. That is what the help is there for.
affirmations.text: Kuuliza kuhusu msaada wa bili ni busara, si aibu. Ndiyo maana msaada huo upo.

affirmations.en: A free afternoon at the park can be the best day of the week.
affirmations.text: Mchana wa bure bustanini unaweza kuwa siku bora ya wiki.

affirmations.en: You stretched it one more week. That takes real skill.
affirmations.text: Ulifanya pesa zitoshe wiki moja zaidi. Hilo linahitaji ujuzi wa kweli.

affirmations.en: Worrying about money is tiring. You are carrying a lot, and you are still here.
affirmations.text: Kuhangaikia pesa kunachosha. Unabeba mengi, na bado uko hapa.

affirmations.en: You drank a glass of water today. Start there.
affirmations.text: Leo ulikunywa glasi ya maji. Anzia hapo.

affirmations.en: Everyone got out the door. The shoes may not have matched. Still a win.
affirmations.text: Kila mtu alitoka mlangoni. Huenda viatu havikulingana. Bado ni ushindi.

affirmations.en: You made the phone call you were dreading. That was brave.
affirmations.text: Ulipiga ile simu uliyokuwa ukiiogopa. Huo ulikuwa ujasiri.

affirmations.en: You laughed today. Hold on to that.
affirmations.text: Leo ulicheka. Shikilia hilo.

affirmations.en: A warm meal, a clean shirt, a bedtime story. Small things add up to a childhood.
affirmations.text: Chakula cha moto, shati safi, hadithi kabla ya kulala. Vitu vidogo hujenga utoto.

affirmations.en: Today you were kind to someone, even if it was only yourself.
affirmations.text: Leo ulimfanyia mtu wema, hata kama ni wewe mwenyewe tu.

affirmations.en: Progress, not perfect. You moved forward today.
affirmations.text: Hatua, si ukamilifu. Leo umesonga mbele.

affirmations.en: You finished one thing on the list. That is one more than none.
affirmations.text: Umemaliza jambo moja kwenye orodha. Hilo ni moja zaidi ya hakuna.

affirmations.en: You are a good mom. The fact that you worry about it shows how much you care.
affirmations.text: Wewe ni mama mwema. Kuwa na wasiwasi kuhusu hilo kunaonyesha jinsi unavyojali.

affirmations.en: You are more than what you get done in a day.
affirmations.text: Wewe ni zaidi ya kile unachoweza kumaliza kwa siku moja.

affirmations.en: Your kids do not need a perfect mom. They need you, and they have you.
affirmations.text: Watoto wako hawahitaji mama mkamilifu. Wanakuhitaji wewe, na uko nao.

affirmations.en: Be as patient with yourself as you are with your kids.
affirmations.text: Kuwa mvumilivu kwako mwenyewe kama unavyowavumilia watoto wako.

affirmations.en: You are allowed to take up space, to want things and to have your own dreams.
affirmations.text: Una haki ya kuchukua nafasi, kutamani vitu na kuwa na ndoto zako mwenyewe.

affirmations.en: A mistake does not cancel out love. Tomorrow is a fresh start.
affirmations.text: Kosa halifuti upendo. Kesho ni mwanzo mpya.

affirmations.en: You are someone’s whole world, and you are also your own person.
affirmations.text: Wewe ni ulimwengu mzima wa mtu fulani, na pia wewe ni mtu wako mwenyewe.

affirmations.en: It is okay not to love every minute. You can still love your kids with your whole heart.
affirmations.text: Ni sawa kutofurahia kila dakika. Bado unaweza kuwapenda watoto wako kwa moyo wako wote.

affirmations.en: There is no one right way to be a mom. Your way is allowed.
affirmations.text: Hakuna njia moja tu sahihi ya kuwa mama. Njia yako inakubalika.

affirmations.en: Like tree pose, it is okay to wobble. You can find your balance again.
affirmations.text: Kama katika mkao wa mti, ni sawa kuyumba. Unaweza kupata usawa wako tena.

affirmations.en: Plant your feet like mountain pose. You are steadier than you feel.
affirmations.text: Simamisha miguu yako imara kama katika mkao wa mlima. Uko imara kuliko unavyojisikia.

affirmations.en: Warrior two: strong legs, open arms. That is you, facing this week.
affirmations.text: Shujaa wa pili: miguu yenye nguvu, mikono iliyonyooshwa. Huyo ni wewe, ukiikabili wiki hii.

affirmations.en: Breathe in for four, out for four. You are right here, and you are doing okay.
affirmations.text: Vuta pumzi hadi nne, toa hadi nne. Uko hapa, na unaendelea vizuri.

affirmations.en: Stretch wide like a star. You are allowed to take up room.
affirmations.text: Jinyooshe kwa upana kama nyota. Una haki ya kuchukua nafasi.

affirmations.en: A wide, low squat is hard to hold. So is a long day. You are holding it.
affirmations.text: Kuchuchumaa kwa upana na chini ni vigumu kudumu. Siku ndefu pia. Na unadumu.

affirmations.en: You can lean like a crescent moon and still be standing.
affirmations.text: Unaweza kuinama kama mwezi mchanga na bado ukasimama.

affirmations.en: You do not have to reach your toes yet. Every bit of a stretch counts.
affirmations.text: Huhitaji kufikia vidole vya miguu bado. Kila kunyoosha kidogo kunahesabika.

affirmations.en: Triangle pose: one hand down, one hand up. Stay grounded and keep reaching.
affirmations.text: Mkao wa pembetatu: mkono mmoja chini, mmoja juu. Kaa imara na endelea kunyoosha.

affirmations.en: It is late. Whatever did not get done today can wait until tomorrow.
affirmations.text: Ni usiku sana. Kisichofanyika leo kinaweza kusubiri hadi kesho.

affirmations.en: Up with the baby at this hour? Lots of moms are awake with you right now.
affirmations.text: Uko macho na mtoto saa hii? Akina mama wengi wako macho pamoja nawe sasa hivi.

affirmations.en: The house is quiet. This moment is yours. Breathe.
affirmations.text: Nyumba imetulia. Wakati huu ni wako. Pumua.

affirmations.en: You made it through today. That is all today needed.
affirmations.text: Umeivuka siku ya leo. Hilo ndilo pekee leo ilihitaji.

affirmations.en: If your mind is busy tonight, write it down and let it wait until morning.
affirmations.text: Kama akili yako haitulii usiku huu, yaandike na uyaache yasubiri hadi asubuhi.

affirmations.en: Rest your eyes. Tomorrow you get to start again.
affirmations.text: Pumzisha macho yako. Kesho unaweza kuanza upya.

affirmations.en: Holidays can be hard as well as happy. Whatever this season feels like for you is okay.
affirmations.text: Sikukuu zinaweza kuwa ngumu pamoja na kuwa za furaha. Vyovyote unavyojisikia msimu huu, ni sawa.

affirmations.en: The table does not need to be perfect. The people around it are what matter.
affirmations.text: Meza haihitaji kuwa kamilifu. Watu walio kuizunguka ndio muhimu.

affirmations.en: If you are missing someone at the table this year, be gentle with your heart.
affirmations.text: Kama mwaka huu unamkosa mtu mezani, kuwa mpole kwa moyo wako.

affirmations.en: Thank you, mom, for every meal, every ride and every hug.
affirmations.text: Asante, mama, kwa kila mlo, kila safari na kila kumbatio.

affirmations.en: You do not have to host, bake or smile through all of it. A simple holiday is still a holiday.
affirmations.text: Huhitaji kukaribisha wageni, kuoka au kutabasamu muda wote. Sikukuu rahisi bado ni sikukuu.

affirmations.en: The best gift your kids get this year is time with you.
affirmations.text: Zawadi bora watakayopata watoto wako mwaka huu ni muda pamoja nawe.

affirmations.en: A small holiday is still full of love. It does not take a lot of money to make it special.
affirmations.text: Sherehe ndogo nayo imejaa upendo. Haihitaji pesa nyingi ili iwe maalum.

affirmations.en: Cold days, warm hugs. You are the warm place in your house.
affirmations.text: Siku za baridi, makumbatio ya joto. Wewe ndiye joto la nyumba yako.

affirmations.en: It is okay to skip some of the holiday rush. Peace counts as a present.
affirmations.text: Ni sawa kuruka baadhi ya pilikapilika za sikukuu. Amani nayo ni zawadi.

affirmations.en: If the season is heavy this year, you are not alone. Take it one day at a time.
affirmations.text: Kama msimu huu ni mzito kwako mwaka huu, hauko peke yako. Siku moja baada ya nyingine.
